brands.name: Iron Cross Surfboards
brands.short_description: Cardiff-by-the-Sea family shaping bay — Jeff Grygera shapes and his son Jay glasses Iron Cross longboards, shortboards, and fish at their San Marcos factory.

models.name: The 5150
models.description: The 5150 is our Performance nose rider. Everyone wants the best of both worlds and we did just that. Featuring our motherlode nose with a bevel and slight nose concave into a comp tail that can be any shape. Lots of edge in the tail with a deep double barrel between the 2+1 fin setup.

models.name: Motherlode
models.description: The Motherlode is our classic all around nose rider. With the wide square tail for stability on the nose this board makes everyday fun. The nose is wide with a slight nose concave but not to much which does not slow down the paddling power of this board.

models.name: The Pancho Villa
models.description: The Pancho Villa is inspired from a board Jeff use to ride as a kid at Cardiff Reef. It has a rolled bottom with a pinched out 50/50 rails.

models.name: The Comp
models.description: The Comp is our most famous and loved board. If you want to surf your long board like a short board this is the one. Thin, light weight and fast!

models.name: The Red Baron
models.description: The Red Baron is another classic that has been with us since the beginning. It's our comp model but just a little wider and thicker for extra floatation.

models.name: The Daily Driver
models.description: The Daily Driver is our newest nose rider. Hands down the new favorite of the guys at the shop. This board paddles like a dream because of its low rocker. A couple key features is the tail shape and fin box placement at 4''.

models.name: The Trog
models.description: The Trog is our all around short board. With the wide point pushed forward into the chest area this allows better paddling. Also with a lower rocker and single to double concave through the bottom makes this board super fun. Perfect for punchy little beach break or over head surf it can handle anything.

models.name: The Push Up
models.description: The Push up is our high performance short board with just a little more width in the nose. Bottom consist of flat in the nose to single concave to double barrel between the fins. Also has a nice full soft rail. We find this works great for San Diego surf. Any tail shape can be shaped in to this board.

models.name: California Gold
models.description: If you had to choose only one board…. The California Gold is just that. It is one of our newest and very versatile models due to its design. It has a wider and slight beak nose that hides foam for easy paddling, a nice rounded pin, and hard tail edge that goes up 1/3 of the board for drive. This board is recommended as a 2+1 but could easily be fun as a single fin. Recommended wave size are as little as you want to double overhead.

models.name: The Mod Fish
models.description: The Mod fish has a curvy attractive outline that makes the board move rail to rail. The tail has slight double bump wing that helps bring in the tail to a baby swallow tail. The bottom consist of a single concave with a quad fin set up.

models.name: Retro Fish
models.description: Our Retro Fish is straight from the 70's. Jeff use to shape a lot of boards like this! Featuring a classic beak nose that helps keep foam in the nose and chest area for extra volume and flotation that equates to paddle power. Available with glass ons or a removable fin system for fin variety.

models.name: The DBD
models.description: The Double Black Diamon "DBD". Well theres a lot going on here. First it has a cut off blunt nose with a straight outline. This makes the board go super fast. The bottom starts of flat in the nose to a single concave to a double barrel between the fins. We also put in two little channels out of the rear quads. We find this acts like little fins when riding it as a quad fin. Allowing the board to be fast down the line but also releasing for top turns.
